utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, right—the carpool. I haven’t heard any changes yet, but I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if anything comes up.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Tess — just to confirm, no changes yet, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s right, no changes yet. If I hear anything, I’ll tell you right away.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll keep Noah posted and repeat the carpool plan if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Vik — appreciate it. Just keep me posted if the plan shifts.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do — I’ll let you know right away if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what time should I be ready?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll swing by around 7:30, so just be ready then.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect, I’ll be ready at 7:30.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hi Cleo — I’m happy to help with the carpool. What time do you need me?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey — could you do 8:15? That should give us enough time to get everyone there.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure — 8:15 works for me. I’ll be there on time.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Morning! I can do carpool pickup after school on Tuesday, if that still works for you.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That still works great, thank you! I’ll plan on Tuesday after school and let the others know.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect — I’ll see you then, and I’ll keep an eye out for the kids after school Tuesday.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m happy to help with the carpool—what’s the plan and what time should I be ready?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—sorry, I’m a bit scattered today. Let’s plan for 7:30, and I’ll text you if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—7:30 works for me. Just send a text if the plan changes.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Pia, I’m putting together the carpool—want in? I can send you the details right now.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m interested, but can you send the pickup times and route first? I need to make sure the logistics work for me.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send the pickup times and route right now so you can check them over.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve been hearing bits and pieces about the carpool—what’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: We’ve got a draft route and a few families confirmed, and I’m just ironing out the pickup times now. I can send you the latest list if you’d like.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That would be great—please send me the latest list when you can. I’ve only heard bits and pieces, so I’d love to catch up.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Just to make sure I have the details right—what time is the carpool, and who’s riding with us?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: The carpool’s at 7:30, and it’s just you, me, and Ben.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — 7:30 with just the three of us, you, me, and Ben. Thanks for clarifying.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, I can do carpool this week. Just need a little notice in case anything comes up.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Uli — I’ll give you a heads-up if I’m joining. Appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane. That helps a lot—just text me when you know.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — if you need a hand with the carpool, I can pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus. What days and times can you help?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’m free most weekday mornings and again after 5 on Mondays and Wednesdays. If you tell me the schedule, I can work around it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m still figuring out the pickup spots—what time and which address should I note for the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Let’s do 7:30 at my place—123 Maple St. I’ll be ready out front.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — 7:30 at 123 Maple St., out front. I’ll note that for the carpool.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — if you need anything for the carpool, I’ve got a cooler, a phone mount, and a jumper cable set you can borrow.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus. The phone mount would help a lot for the carpool.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Of course — I’ll bring the phone mount by later, and you can keep it for the carpool.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m a bit worried about the timing—what time are we leaving, and who’s picking up whom?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I’m not sure yet—can you confirm the departure time and the pickup order?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can check, but I need the exact departure time first. Once we have that, I’ll map out the pickup order.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Mara, I can help coordinate the carpool—who needs a ride and what time should we aim for?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Jules—that’d be a huge help. I’ll check who needs a ride and get back to you with a time.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good—just send me the list and I’ll line up the rides.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good—what time are we carpooling, and do you want me to bring anything?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’ll probably join a little late—can we plan for around 8:15? And no need to bring anything, thanks.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: 8:15 works for me—I’ll save you a spot. See you then!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Faye, have you heard if the carpool time’s still the same this week? I can pass along any updates if you want.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I haven’t heard any changes yet, so let’s keep it at the same time for now. If anything comes up, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, I’ll keep it at the usual time and let everyone know it’s unchanged for now.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — what’s the carpool plan?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ll send out the route and pickup times this afternoon, and I’ll make sure everyone has the updated list.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — thanks. Just send it when you can.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing—what time do you need the carpool, and who’s coming along?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Around 7:30 works for me, and it’s just me.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good—I can do 7:30 for just you.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ll spread the word about the carpool and see who’s in. Want me to ask around this afternoon?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, please—thanks for asking around this afternoon. I’ll wait to hear what you find.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll ask around this afternoon and let you know who’s in.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Eli — I’m ready to keep track of the carpool. Where should I note the pickup spot and time?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s keep it simple: write the pickup spot and time in one place, and I’ll stick to that. If it changes, just let me know ahead of time.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sounds good — I’ll keep the pickup spot and time together and let you know ahead of time if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Hana, are we still on for the carpool tomorrow? What time should I be ready?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, we’re still on—please be ready by 7:15 tomorrow morning so we can leave on time.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I’ll be ready by 7:15. See you then!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh hey, did the carpool time change, or is it still the same as usual?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, I’m not sure—I think it might be the usual time, but I should check and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, that’d be great — just let me know when you check.
